stories.title: Flash flood kills at least eight in Nepal, Americans reported missing
new_facts: British embassy joint statement (with Australia, EU, Finland, France, Norway, Switzerland) on floods; 12 Britons missing.
An avalanche of ice and rock is reported to have triggered the flash floods; 8 killed.
Experts link the disaster to climate change and the region's vulnerability to extreme weather.
22 bodies recovered, 384 people reported missing; major casualties at Gyirong Port, Tibet.
Americans confirmed among the nearly 400 missing tourists.
Australian reported missing; death toll now nine; ~300 foreign nationals missing.
Claims the flash flood was triggered by an earthquake, not an avalanche.
Three American tourists specifically identified among the 384 missing.
stories.line: Flash flooding in Nepal killed at least eight people and damaged roads and power infrastructure; some Americans are among the missing.

stories.title: Core inflation rises 3.3% as energy prices keep pressure on costs
new_facts: New PCE inflation report: core prices up 3.3% annually in July, below the 3.6% forecast.
PCE gauge was unchanged month-over-month in July while remaining elevated year-over-year.
UK energy price cap rises, pushing household bills to their highest level since July 2023.
stories.line: Core inflation stayed elevated at 3.3% in July, driven partly by energy costs, as the Fed watches price growth remain above its 2% target.

stories.title: Tesco recalls salad over E. coli contamination risk
stories.line: Tesco recalled a meal-deal salad after discovering possible E. coli contamination; customers are warned not to eat affected products.

stories.title: Bill Gates warns AI poses economic threat, calls for regulation and labor protections
new_facts: Introduces Bill Gates essay warning AI era will be turbulent, calling for regulatory framework.
Gates says industry downplays AI risks including mass unemployment and bioterrorism.
Gates proposes 'human reserved' jobs; essay is 6,000 words long.
Gates says human-only jobs and token taxes will be required, new on-record quotes.
stories.line: Bill Gates warns AI will cause massive workforce disruption and calls for regulatory frameworks and job protections.

stories.title: Chicago Sky bans Enes Kanter Freedom after confrontation with player
stories.line: WNBA's Chicago Sky banned activist Enes Kanter Freedom from home games following a confrontation with player Natasha Cloud.

stories.title: CIA director secretly meets Russian intelligence in Moscow
new_facts: Kremlin now confirms Ratcliffe held talks with Russian intelligence counterparts in Moscow.
Kremlin specifies Ratcliffe met Russian intelligence services but did not meet Putin.
Peskov named as Kremlin spokesman, quoted saying too early to say if contacts improve US-Russia relations.
Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin confirms Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow resumed hours after Ratcliffe's visit.
Russia is escalating hybrid attacks (cyber, drones, arson) against countries supplying Ukraine, Europe lacks response.
stories.line: CIA Director Ratcliffe made a secret trip to Moscow to meet Russian intelligence officials, not Putin, as Ukraine paused strikes on the capital.

stories.title: Graham wins South Carolina GOP Senate runoff with Trump endorsement
new_facts: Mentions a new, unspecified development in the Alaska Senate race with November implications
New on-record Norman quote: 'I never understood why he got in this race,' referring to Trump
New Graham victory-speech quote: 'Our victory would not have been possible without you'
Reveals Graham's age (62) and names Democratic general-election opponent Annie Andrews
Frames Graham's win as preserving Trump's undefeated streak in GOP Senate primaries this year.
New stats: Trump-endorsed candidates had lost 10 GOP contests this cycle, six in prior two weeks, amid falling approval ratings.
Norman's supporters booed Trump during his concession speech after the SC runoff loss.
stories.line: Lindsey Graham's sister Darline won South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff with Trump's backing, advancing to November's general election.

stories.title: Energy price cap rises 4% in October as bills hit three-year high
new_facts: Ofgem sets 4% price cap rise (+£60/yr) to £1,723 from Oct 1; Burnham calls bills rise 'difficult'
stories.line: UK energy price cap rises 4% in October; typical bills increase £60 annually.

stories.title: Met Office warns of heavy thunderstorms and flash floods across UK
stories.line: Britain faces heavy thunderstorms with up to 75mm rainfall expected; flood warnings issued across multiple regions.

stories.title: Iran, Oman negotiate Hormuz corridor as U.S. weighs sanctions leverage
new_facts: Iran and Oman near deal for future joint administration of Hormuz; US holds back on secondary sanctions.
Iran calls sanctions 'gross lawlessness', predicts many countries won't join, claims Washington now seeks talks.
stories.line: Iran and Oman are negotiating a transit corridor through the Strait of Hormuz; the U.S. is weighing whether to enforce secondary sanctions against Iran's trading partners.
